head.name: @fzlt/core/grid
head.lead: The game board. A cols × rows tile grid in typed arrays (terrain id, move cost, flags), A* paths, line of sight, movement range and seeded terrain. Every search reuses buffers made once by board(), so no call allocates. Cell ids are row * cols + col. Not collision: @fzlt/core/collide's Grid re-buckets moving bodies every step; a Board holds the ground they move over. Use the same cell size for both and a body's collide bucket is its cell. The size is checked at setup: cols and rows are positive integers, cell a finite number > 0 (a RangeError names all three). A search (path, flood, los, hit) checks its cell ids: an id that is not an integer on the board throws fizlet/grid: cell … is not on the board.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
